extracted text: The paper investigates the influence of high-temperature pre-precipitation treatment on corrosion behaviors of 7055 aluminum alloy. The alloy was subjected to different heat treatment processes detailed in Table 2: Sample 1 was solution treated at 450°C/1h + 470°C/1h + 480°C/3h followed by aging at 130°C/24h; Sample 2 had the same solution treatment plus 465°C/0.5h pre-precipitation before aging; Sample 3 had the same solution treatment plus 455°C/0.5h pre-precipitation before aging.
property mapping:
- UTS = Ultimate Tensile Strength (MPa)
- YS = Yield Strength (MPa)
- El = Elongation (%)
- Hardness = Hardness in Rockwell B scale (HRB)
- KIC = Fracture toughness (MPa m1/2)
- KISCC = Stress intensity factor for stress corrosion cracking (MPa m1/2)
abbreviations:
- Bal = Balance (remainder is aluminum)
- HRB = Hardness Rockwell B scale
- SCC = Stress Corrosion Crack
- HTPP = High-Temperature Pre-Precipitation
- PFZ = Precipitate Free Zone
- IGC = Inter-Granular Corrosion
